questions.q: When using a fire extinguisher, the acronym **PASS** stands for:
questions.explain: PASS is the standard mnemonic for fire extinguisher use: Pull the pin, Aim at the base of the fire, Squeeze the handle, Sweep from side to side.
questions.subject: Biotechnology

questions.q: If a strong acid is spilled on a lab coat and soaks through to the skin, what is the immediate recommended procedure?
options: Wipe the acid off with a paper towel and continue working.
Go to the safety shower, remove the contaminated clothing, and rinse for 15 minutes.
Apply a neutralizing base like baking soda directly to the skin.
Wait until the end of the shift to wash the area.
questions.explain: Immediate decontamination is required. The victim should use the safety shower to flush the area with water for at least 15 minutes while removing the contaminated clothing. Neutralizing burns on skin is not recommended as the reaction can generate heat and worsen the injury.
